zh-CN.title: 脚本工作流
zh-CN.description: 运行可检查的 Agent 脚本工作流，跟踪步骤进度，并按保留版本确认成果。

usage.title: 打开脚本工作流
usage.description: 进入工作流页面，准备一个受支持的 JavaScript 工作流及其输入参数。

usage.title: 提交并查看执行过程
usage.description: 启动后查看步骤进度、Agent 子会话和执行结果；需要人工确认的步骤会等待你的处理。

usage.title: 按保留版本确认成果
usage.description: 检查实际保留的输出版本，再确认或继续工作流。重启恢复取决于工作流和部署是否支持。

requirements: 管理员已配置可调用的 Agent 和持久化存储；Gateway 运行在 Linux 或 macOS。

en-US.title: Script workflows
en-US.description: Run inspectable Agent workflows, track steps and review retained output versions.

usage.title: Open Script workflows
usage.description: Open the workflow page and prepare a supported JavaScript workflow and its input arguments.

usage.title: Run and inspect
usage.description: Start the workflow and inspect steps, Agent conversations and results. Human checkpoints wait for your response.

usage.title: Review retained output
usage.description: Inspect the retained output version before approving or continuing. Restart recovery depends on workflow and deployment compatibility.

requirements: The administrator must configure allowed Agents and persistent storage on a Linux or macOS Gateway.
